name: Koyoi mo Meshimase Alicetale
source:
The protagonist is a university student with a part-time job, living alone. One day, he receives a mysterious, cross-patterned trunk from his parents, who are currently working overseas. Attached is a letter with a duplicate key. Confused, the protagonist opens the trunk and finds a girl sleeping inside...
